subject: Mutual Action Plan: hosting path, region constraints, and pilot timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia@northforgehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff + hosting & region checklist

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Per our call, I’m attaching a first-draft MAP and a short SOC2 summary so your security team can start a parallel review. High-level asks / proposals from Redwood: 

- MAP milestone A: pilot on Hosted API (US region) — 2 week pilot to validate latency and integration flows.
- MAP milestone B: EU-residency option — either Dedicated capacity in eu-west-1 or Private (VPC) deploy depending on PHI requirements.
- Evaluation plan: technical deep-dive with Jordan (infra) and Monica (security), then a 2-week smoke test with rolling performance metrics.

Please review the MAP and let me know where you want us to tighten timelines (we can compress the pilot to 1 week if priority). Next concrete step: schedule the tech deep-dive — are you available Thu 5/6 or Fri 5/7 (30–60 min)?

Attaching: NForge_MAP_v1.2.pdf, SOC2-summary-Redwood.pdf

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0128
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia@northforgehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: NorthForge Procurement <procurement@northforgehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff + hosting & region checklist

Marissa —

Thanks, this is helpful. A few clarifying points from our side:

- Security/regulatory: NorthForge handles PHI; EU residency is a hard requirement for any workload that contains identifiable European patient data.
- Preferred path: We’d like to understand Private (VPC/on-prem) as the long-term target, but pragmatically we need an immediate pilot to unblock product validation.
- Question on Hosted: If we pilot on Redwood’s Hosted in the US, how do you handle cross-border replication? Is there a guaranteed no-replication of EU data to US?

Procurement is copied for timing — we typically need a 2–3 week mutual action plan to get approvals, so your proposed pilot window is tight but possibly workable. I’ve attached our security questionnaire — can your security team start on that concurrently?

Alicia Moreno
VP Product, NorthForge Health
alicia@northforgehealth.com

To: Alicia Moreno <alicia@northforgehealth.com>

Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff + hosting & region checklist

On Tue, May 4, 2027 at 09:04, Alicia Moreno <alicia@northforgehealth.com> wrote:
> Marissa —
> 
> Thanks, this is helpful. A few clarifying points from our side:
> 
> - Security/regulatory: NorthForge handles PHI; EU residency is a hard requirement for any workload that contains identifiable European patient data.
> - Preferred path: We’d like to understand Private (VPC/on-prem) as the long-term target, but pragmatically we need an immediate pilot to unblock product validation.
> - Question on Hosted: If we pilot on Redwood’s Hosted in the US, how do you handle cross-border replication? Is there a guaranteed no-replication of EU data to US?

Thanks for the quick reply. Short answers first: we can support a pilot on Hosted with strict tenancy and data handling constraints, but we cannot host EU-resident PHI in our US public Hosted endpoints. Options to satisfy both speed-to-value and residency: 

- Short path (fastest): Pilot on Hosted with synthetic or de-identified data to validate integration and UX. No EU PHI leaves your environment.
- Medium path: Dedicated pool provisioned in eu-west-1 (reserved capacity) — gets you EU residency and predictable throughput, 2–3 week lead to schedule capacity.
- Long path: Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) — best for full PHI compliance and custom networking; estimated 8–12 week delivery depending on infra handoff.

I’m attaching a one-pager (Hosted_vs_Dedicated_quickchart.pdf) that summarizes trade-offs (latency, cost, lead time). Jordan and Monica can run the technical deep-dive to verify the mapping for your use cases; do you prefer Thu 5/6 10:00–10:30am PT or Fri 5/7 09:00–09:30am PT?

If you’re comfortable, we’ll also start the security questionnaire review in parallel — Monica will take point.

Best,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole | Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia@northforgehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff + hosting & region checklist — pricing & timeline notes

Alicia / team —

Two quick commercial notes to align expectations while technical review runs: 

- Pricing: For Dedicated capacity we can offer a 10% commit discount on a 12-month reserved pool (deal ND-2027-1147). Private deployment pricing is evaluated case-by-case (license + deployment) — I’ll follow up with a one-page estimate.
- Timeline: If NorthForge signs the MAP by May 12 we can target a Hosted pilot start week of May 17. Dedicated eu-west-1 provisioning lead is ~2–3 weeks after signed commitment. Private target pushes into July unless we front-load infra work.
- Procurement: I’ve uploaded initial SOW + redline guide to HubSpot (link below). If procurement wants to proceed with a fast path, we can do signature via DocuSign and start onboarding immediately after.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ND-2027-1147

Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks —

We’ll proceed with this plan:

1) Pilot: Hosted (US) on synthetic data to validate integration and UX — target start May 17.
2) Residency: Simultaneously, start procurement conversations for Dedicated eu-west-1; procurement will review your SOW this week.
3) Security: I’m attaching our filled questionnaire (Nforge_security_q.pdf). Please have Monica and the security team review and confirm any open items by May 10 — we need to close security gating before pilot start.

On scheduling: Thu 5/6 10:00am PT works for the tech deep-dive.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — procurement copied.

— Alicia
